## ac4b61e7b230

**Reproduced defect: active authority text divergence.** Generator SHA-256 `7472decbbed2b49988fa904d58283f5cafb85897b6e131000f6fcd2fd7a9270e` declares rule hash `736dca1f0b72`, and execution parity passes, but the official authority-sync stage exits 1 because canonical and selected active `target_code` form two exact-text groups. Evidence: `checks/audit-ac4b61e7b230-authority/checks/ac4b61e7b230_before_authority_sync.log`.

The portable task suite also exits 1 (11 passed, 3 failed): two failures use a guessed data path unavailable in the snapshot, and one asserts the divergent raw/selected source equals canonical. Evidence: `checks/audit-ac4b61e7b230-task-tests-console.log`. I did not find a movement-semantic counterexample in the generator source or its eight declared spatial relations, but the active authority and portable-test defects are sufficient to block a clean review. No files for this audit target were changed.
